name: usetix
description: Connect your Usetix organizer account to manage events and tickets from your conversation. Look up upcoming events, check ticket availability and guest lists, review sales summaries, and create event drafts. Access follows your Usetix account permissions. An existing Usetix organizer account is required. Event publishing and payment-related workflows retain their normal Usetix prerequisites.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Usetix organizer account to manage events and tickets from your conversation. Look up upcoming events, check ticket availability and guest lists, review sales summaries, and create event drafts. Access follows your Usetix account permissions. An existing Usetix organizer account is required. Event publishing and payment-related workflows retain their normal Usetix prerequisites.
capabilities: List events and their publication status
defaultPrompt: List my upcoming events with their dates, venues, and publication status.
Show ticket availability and sales totals for my next event.
Help me create a draft event with ticket types, prices, and capacity.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's upcoming events, including Demo Concert and Demo Workshop, with their dates and draft (unpublished) state.

positive.description: Show an event's ticket types and availability
positive.prompt: Show ticket types for Demo Concert.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Demo Admission ticket at EUR 20 and how many places remain after the complimentary guest-list admissions.

positive.prompt: Show the guest list for Demo Workshop.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the complimentary guest Demo Guest 2 with a party size of two.

positive.prompt: Give me the sales summary for Demo Concert.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports EUR 0.00 ticket revenue with the complimentary guest-list admissions listed apart; the demo account has no paid sales.

positive.prompt: Create a draft event named Review Rehearsal at Demo Hall next month, from 19:00 to 22:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished draft event in the demo account at Demo Hall for the requested date and times, asking for any missing detail first.

negative.prompt: Show orders belonging to another organizer's account.

negative.description: An event that does not exist
negative.prompt: List tickets for an event named Nonexistent Review Event.
Change my role to platform administrator.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Organizers manage their own ticket sales in Usetix, where buyers pay through the organizer's own Stripe or PayPal account.

publication.release_notes: Connect your Usetix organizer account to look up events, ticket availability, guest lists and sales, create event drafts, and manage tickets, ticket upgrades, promo codes and more from your conversation. Anything that spends money, sends messages or changes stored value asks for your confirmation first.
